title: Every READY-INTEGRATE packet to Merger carries a complete evidence map before it gets a gate slot
outcome: Merger never stalls after a passing gate for evaluation-only reasons. Every input packet handed to Merger names, before the packet gets a gate slot: the review-pair delegation ids; the repair-review ids for any post-review fix; a carry or disjoint-tree assessment against the current master; the focused and gate run ids with fingerprints; and a criterion-to-evidence map for each item. Validation is not weakened: the evaluator still judges every criterion independently.
acceptance: A written READY-INTEGRATE packet template lists the five required fields: review-pair ids; repair-review ids; carry or disjoint-tree assessment naming the base commit; focused and gate run ids with fingerprints; and the per-item criterion-to-evidence map, with each entry pointing to a note, record or delegation id the evaluator can read. The template is recorded as a project memory and sent to every TermAl lane and to Merger.
Merger refuses a gate slot to a packet missing any field and names the missing field; it doesn't fill gaps itself.
For the next three batches landed after adoption, no landing stalls after a passing gate because evidence wasn't visible to the evaluator. Any stall that does occur is recorded with its cause.
